'''Cube 24556''' was the [[cube]] apartment of [[Teela Kaarz]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was located in [[Resiplex 19]].

Teela treated [[Villian Dance]] to dinner there after an [[Attack on the first Death Star|attack on the Death Star]].
